questions.question: How many working days of paternity leave are available?
questions.answer: Eligible employees receive 15 working days of paid paternity leave.

questions.question: How much home-office equipment can an employee claim?
questions.answer: Up to ₹25,000 once every 24 months, cumulatively across eligible equipment.

questions.question: How many remote-work days per week are normally allowed?
questions.answer: Up to 3 remote days per week for eligible hybrid employees.

questions.question: What is the domestic hotel ceiling?
questions.answer: ₹8,000 per night excluding applicable taxes.

questions.question: How many approvals are required for security-sensitive production code changes?
questions.answer: At least 2 approvals, including one reviewer with relevant security ownership.

questions.question: What environments does Northstar use?
questions.answer: Development, staging, and production.

questions.question: How quickly must a SEV-1 incident be acknowledged?
questions.answer: Within 15 minutes.

questions.question: Can production secrets be committed to source control?
questions.answer: No. Production secrets must be stored in the approved secrets-management system.

questions.question: What approval is required for an expense of ₹35,000?
questions.answer: Manager and department-head approval.

questions.question: When is a purchase order required?
questions.answer: Before committing the company to purchases above ₹25,000 unless an approved exception applies.

questions.question: Who approves release readiness before production?
questions.answer: The product owner approves release readiness after QA completes the agreed test scope.

questions.question: How long is the normal API deprecation notice?
questions.answer: At least 6 months before shutdown.

questions.question: What is an example of Restricted data?
questions.answer: Production credentials, private cryptographic keys, highly sensitive personal data, and security investigation evidence are examples.

questions.question: How long can annual leave be carried forward?
questions.answer: Up to 12 working days into the next calendar year.

questions.question: What is the monthly home-internet reimbursement limit?
questions.answer: Up to ₹1,500 per month when included in the approved remote-work benefit.

questions.question: If I work remotely, can I get reimbursed for an ergonomic chair, and what is the ceiling?
questions.answer: Yes. Approved remote or hybrid employees can claim eligible ergonomic equipment within a cumulative ₹25,000 allowance every 24 months.

questions.question: What is the response-time target for the most severe production incident?
questions.answer: A SEV-1 incident must be acknowledged within 15 minutes.

questions.question: Can I put an API token into Git if it is only for development?
questions.answer: Production secrets must never be committed to source control; secrets should be managed through approved secret-management mechanisms.

questions.question: What level of approval does a ₹40k business purchase need?
questions.answer: A purchase above ₹25,000 and up to ₹100,000 requires manager and department-head approval.

questions.question: How long do we normally give customers before retiring an API version?
questions.answer: At least 6 months of deprecation notice is required before shutdown, except for security emergencies.

questions.question: If a pull request changes authentication, is one reviewer enough?
questions.answer: No. Authentication-related changes require at least 2 approvals, including one reviewer with relevant security ownership.

questions.question: What happens to annual leave above the carry-forward cap?
questions.answer: The balance above 12 working days normally expires on 31 March unless HR approves an exception.

questions.question: Can we roll back a production release if latency suddenly gets bad?
questions.answer: Yes. If error rate, latency, or critical functionality exceeds the service rollback threshold, the release owner should initiate rollback.

questions.question: Which classification should I use if a file contains both internal and confidential material?
questions.answer: Treat the document as Confidential.

questions.question: Does business class become allowed automatically on a long flight?
questions.answer: No. Business class is permitted only for flights longer than 10 hours when the department head approves the exception.

questions.question: I work remotely and need an ergonomic chair. What is the reimbursement limit and what security rule applies to my remote device?
questions.answer: Eligible remote/hybrid employees can claim up to ₹25,000 for approved ergonomic home-office equipment once every 24 months. Remote access must use company-managed devices and the approved VPN on untrusted networks.

questions.question: A production deployment causes severe customer impact. What should the team do about rollback and incident handling?
questions.answer: The release owner should initiate rollback when the service rollback threshold is exceeded, while the incident team should classify and manage the incident according to severity. A SEV-1 requires acknowledgement within 15 minutes and an Incident Commander.

questions.question: A vendor needs access to confidential company data. What procurement and security controls apply?
questions.answer: The vendor must complete onboarding, and Security review is required when a vendor accesses confidential data or privileged resources. Confidential data requires access control based on business need.

questions.question: Can an emergency security fix bypass normal code review and deployment timing?
questions.answer: Emergency changes may bypass normal review when delaying the change creates greater operational or security risk, with retrospective review within 1 business day. Emergency deployments may also occur outside standard windows when needed to mitigate a critical security issue.

questions.question: If a customer-facing release is high risk, what should be prepared before and after deployment?
questions.answer: The release should have a rollout plan, monitoring criteria, and rollback plan; after full rollout, enhanced monitoring should continue for at least 60 minutes.

questions.question: An employee travels internationally and buys a hotel room. Which approval and expense rules apply?
questions.answer: International travel requires manager and department-head approval. Country-specific lodging limits maintained by Finance may apply, and travel expense claims should normally be submitted within 30 calendar days after returning.

questions.question: An API endpoint has a serious security vulnerability. Can its six-month deprecation period be shortened?
questions.answer: Yes. A vulnerable endpoint may be disabled sooner when continued operation creates material security risk, with the decision documented by the security team and API owner.

questions.question: An engineer working from home suspects credentials were exposed. What should happen?
questions.answer: The suspected compromise must be reported immediately to Security and handled as a security incident; relevant logs must not be deleted or altered before investigation.

questions.question: How much can I claim for equipment?
questions.answer: If this means approved home-office equipment, the limit is ₹25,000 cumulatively once every 24 months. Other equipment categories may be governed by different policies.

questions.question: What is the approval threshold for a purchase?
questions.answer: There are multiple thresholds: up to ₹25,000 requires manager approval; above ₹25,000 through ₹100,000 requires manager and department-head approval; above ₹100,000 also requires Finance approval.

questions.question: How long do we keep an API version?
questions.answer: The policy does not define a fixed lifetime. It requires at least 6 months of deprecation notice before shutdown unless a security emergency requires faster retirement.

questions.question: Can I work from home whenever I want?
questions.answer: No. Eligible employees may request hybrid work after 90 days, normally up to 3 remote days per week, subject to role requirements and manager approval.

questions.question: What happens when something goes wrong in production?
questions.answer: The response depends on incident severity. SEV-1, SEV-2, and SEV-3 have different acknowledgement targets and escalation requirements.

questions.question: Can I share this company document externally?
questions.answer: It depends on classification. Public data is approved for unrestricted external distribution; Internal data requires owner approval, and Confidential or Restricted data requires explicit authorization and potentially legal or security review.
